Every resting order of every strategy is cancelled at the exchange and live trading is disarmed. Filled positions are kept and settle normally.

Keys are encrypted with a key held in the phone\'s secure hardware and never leave the device except to sign requests. Paper mode needs no keys.
Create one at kalshi.com > Account > API keys. You get a key id and a private key file (.pem).
BTC deep-ITM trades on Kalshi\'s crypto shard (index 2), which needs its own cash.
Create one at polymarket.us/developer after finishing KYC. The secret is shown once.

Some phones (Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus) also kill background apps in their own battery manager; set Marketbot to Unrestricted there. Keep the phone charging and on Wi-Fi for BTC deep-ITM, which re-quotes every few seconds.
Orders, fills and settlements are kept forever; they are the record. Routine activity lines are deleted after 14 days automatically.
Strategies are ports of pokeehokee/weatherbot and pokeehokee/polymarket, tested against the original Python on recorded inputs.

The latest reading of every value the app has used, where it came from and how old it is. Exchange values are always preferred; CALC means the API has no field for it and the formula is shown. Tap a value to see its origin; Find shows the activity lines that used it.

It runs trading strategies on Kalshi and Polymarket from this phone, around the clock, the way they ran on a desktop.
Every number shows where it came from: the exchange (KALSHI / POLYMARKET), a calculation (CALC), the simulator (PAPER) or your settings. Tap a number for the exact field or formula.
Your keys stay on this phone and are only used to sign requests to the exchanges.
Paper first, real money only on purpose
Everything starts in paper mode: live public prices, simulated orders, nothing sent to an exchange.
Live trading needs a checklist, a preflight, typing LIVE and your fingerprint or screen lock, per strategy.

These strategies win small and often and lose big and rarely: one contract can lose up to about a dollar. Only the weather longshot has made money live, and its last stage check failed. Each card says how strong its evidence is.
Run one bot per account. If a computer is trading the same account, stop it first.
I understand this can lose money
Paper mode needs no keys. Keys let the app show your balances and, when you arm it, trade.
Kalshi: kalshi.com > Account > API keys gives a key id and a .pem file. Its private key goes into this phone\'s secure hardware and cannot be read back out.

Start the weather longshot in paper: it sells cheap YES on Kalshi\'s daily temperature buckets and is the one method with a live record. You\'ll see its first simulated offers on the next hourly pass.
A phone pauses background apps to save battery. Three settings stop that from pausing your strategies.
Each starts in paper. Live needs its checklist, a preflight and your confirmation.
